name: CAwa-NeRF
aliases: Instant Learning of Compression-Aware NeRF Features
definition: A method for instant learning of compression-aware NeRF features that applies an entropy-aware training scheme with a rate-distortion trade-off to learn low entropy features, allowing export of zip-compressed feature grids with negligible overhead without changing the storage architecture or parameters of the base INGP method.
summary: CAwa-NeRF is a compression-aware NeRF method that uses entropy-aware training to produce low-entropy feature grids, enabling efficient zip-compression without altering the base INGP architecture.
